page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn6i-c24g1.12xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 48 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8163 processors running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 186.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 3.88 GB per core. For acceleration, the instance bundles two NVIDIA Turing T4 GPUs, delivering a combined 32 GB of VRAM. It does not include local storage and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 15 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core CPU performance via stress-ng and single-threaded gzip compression are positioned in the bottom 25% and bottom 10% respectively, reflecting the lower clock speed of the older Intel Xeon architecture. However, multi-core performance and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression reach average tiers. Memory bandwidth for both small and large blocks, along with Redis SET operations and static web serving throughput, consistently perform in the middle 50% tier.

Given the dual NVIDIA T4 GPUs and 48 dedicated cores, this instance represents a specialized resource profile. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which is a key architectural tradeoff. It is qualitatively structured for workloads that can leverage GPU acceleration and parallel processing, such as machine learning inference, video transcoding, and multi-threaded compute tasks, rather than single-threaded CPU-bound operations.
